title: She Smuggled 2,500 Children Out in Tool Boxes and Coffins
description:
Irena Sendler, a Polish social worker, smuggled roughly 2,500 Jewish children out of the Warsaw Ghetto during WWII, hiding their real names in jars buried in a garden.

Did you know this actually happened? Let me know in the comments.
